name: Product Launch
description: A clean, restrained product launch / waitlist landing page for a dev-focused product, built with semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Light, neutral, and typography-driven: a sticky header with brand mark, anchor nav, theme toggle, and responsive mobile drawer; an editorial hero with a clamp() headline, status meta, and a working waitlist card (name + email validation, simulated submission, success state, beta-capacity progress bar); a social-proof logo row; a three-column feature grid; a four-step how-it-works list; a two-plan pricing teaser; a single-open FAQ accordion (CSS-grid 0fr->1fr, aria-expanded/controls/region); and a final CTA panel + footer. Split into modular files: code.html + style.css (the --ds-* design-token system from design-tokens.md, light-default + calm opt-in dark mode, reduced-motion guard) + script.js (theme toggle, mobile nav, accordion, waitlist form validation, reveal), with preview.html as a self-contained single-file preview. No React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, or backend.
features: sticky header with brand mark, version badge, anchor nav, theme toggle, and responsive mobile drawer (aria-expanded)
editorial hero with clamp() headline, status meta row (status / launch / platforms)
working waitlist card: name + work-email fields with inline validation, simulated submission, success state, and beta-capacity progress bar
four-step how-it-works list with numbered rail
two-plan pricing teaser (Free / Team) with per-team pricing and feature lists
single-open FAQ accordion (CSS-grid 0fr->1fr, aria-expanded/aria-controls/role=region, chevron rotate)
final CTA panel with primary + secondary actions
light-default theme with calm opt-in dark mode (no-flash pre-paint script + persisted toggle)
DevSnips --ds-* shared design-token layer (design-tokens.md) with template tokens on top
hairline 1px borders, small controlled radii, restrained shadows, single controlled accent
darkMode: opt-in (light default; no-flash system detection + persisted toggle)
browserSupport: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (modern evergreen browsers)
accessibility: semantic HTML landmarks (header, nav, main, section, aside, footer)
ARIA labels on theme toggle, nav toggle, and primary nav
aria-expanded + aria-controls on mobile nav toggle; Escape closes drawer
FAQ accordion: aria-expanded on triggers, aria-controls, role=region, aria-labelledby on panels
form: label + for association, aria-invalid on errors, aria-live polite error messages, role=status success
progress bar exposed as role=img with descriptive aria-label
visible focus states (focus-visible outline on all interactive elements)
keyboard-operable: all controls are native button / a / input
reduced-motion support (prefers-reduced-motion disables animations, smooth scroll, and reveal transforms)
sufficient color contrast in light and dark modes; state conveyed beyond color alone
